    Biotic homogenisation

    Source: R/inv-impact.R
    inv_homogenization.Rd

    Measures whether alien species make communities more similar to each other. Mean pairwise Jaccard and Sorensen similarity among sites is computed for the native assemblage alone and for the current assemblage (native plus alien species). A positive change means homogenisation and a negative change differentiation (Olden and Rooney 2006).

    Usage

    inv_homogenization(.data, site, species, status, native = "native", .by = NULL)

    Arguments

    .data

    A long data frame with one row per species occurrence at a site.

    site, species, status

    <tidy-select> Columns identifying the site, the species and its status.

    native

    Value of status marking native species. Any other value is treated as alien.

    .by

    <tidy-select> Optional grouping columns, for example region.

    Value

    A tibble with one row per group: n_sites, n_native, n_alien, jaccard_native, jaccard_current, delta_jaccard, sorensen_native, sorensen_current, delta_sorensen and homogenised (delta_jaccard > 0). Sites without native species are kept with an empty native assemblage; pairs of empty assemblages are ignored.

    References

    Olden, J. D. and Rooney, T. P. (2006). On defining and quantifying biotic homogenization. Global Ecology and Biogeography, 15, 113-120. doi:10.1111/j.1466-822x.2006.00214.x

    Examples

    inv_homogenization(inv_communities, site = site, species = species,
  status = status, .by = region)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 11
#>   region   n_sites n_native n_alien jaccard_native jaccard_current delta_jaccard
#>   <chr>      <int>    <int>   <int>          <dbl>           <dbl>         <dbl>
#> 1 region_1      12       40      10          0.189           0.261        0.0726
#> 2 region_2      12       39      10          0.190           0.256        0.0665
#> 3 region_3      12       40      10          0.175           0.253        0.0771
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: sorensen_native <dbl>, sorensen_current <dbl>,
#> #   delta_sorensen <dbl>, homogenised <lgl>
